item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — November 9, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Offers Original Games, Not Refusals — Fixed rule: ask for a game copy and Claude builds an original in the same genre.

2. Console Adds IP Allowlist (Beta) — Up to 1,000 addresses or CIDR ranges per org, plus an Admin API force sign-out.

3. Personal Finance and Spend Tags Land — US paid users can link accounts; Enterprise can track spend by cost code.
